text: CAT‑DDO 4 provides immediate liquidity upon government declaration of a State of Calamity or Public Health Emergency, minimizing response time. It is embedded in a Development Policy Loan that supports disaster risk management and financing policy reforms. The facility is part of a layered risk finance strategy that includes parametric insurance, microinsurance, reinsurance, and a sovereign catastrophe bond, offering a diversified safety net for fiscal resilience. It is initially available for three years, with the possibility of renewal up to 15 years.

metadata.solution_name: Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe‑Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT‑DDO 4)
